name: Jaggaer Advanced Sourcing Optimizer (ASO) API
description: The Jaggaer ASO API provides programmatic access to the Advanced Sourcing Optimizer platform for procurement and strategic sourcing. It encompasses three services: Customer Host Entity Service (CHES) for managing customers, users, events, and templates; Event Entity Service (EES) for interacting with event attributes, bids, awards, and suppliers; and Quay Service for submitting and managing optimization jobs.
